quotaExhaustionProbe.environment: Playwright-bundled Chromium, disposable origin http://127.0.0.1:8971, single localStorage key grown in 256KB steps up to a 400-step / ~100MB safety ceiling
quotaExhaustionProbe.result: no QuotaExceededError observed up to ~100MB written to a single key/value in this browser+environment
quotaExhaustionProbe.recoveryAfterProbeCleanup: immediate small write succeeded (localStorage not left in a wedged state)
quotaExhaustionProbe.interpretation: Modern Chromium ties localStorage quota to navigator.storage.estimate()'s disk-relative Storage Standard bucket (observed ~3GB here) rather than the historical fixed 5-10MB per-origin cap. This means the site's actual CRITICAL exposure (silent catch(e){} on every write) is very unlikely to trigger on current desktop/Android Chrome, but its real-world likelihood on Safari/iOS (which has a documented history of much lower and more volatile localStorage limits, especially in Private Browsing and low-storage-pressure eviction) could not be verified in this environment and is flagged as USER REAL-DEVICE REVIEW REQUIRED.
quotaExhaustionProbe.evidence: MEASURED (this run) for Chromium; NOT TESTED for Safari/iOS/Firefox/older Chrome

saveFailureSafety.pattern: function donomanaRecordWriteLog(storageKey, log) { try { localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(log)); } catch (e) {} }
saveFailureSafety.onFailure: silent no-op: entry already pushed into the in-memory array by donomanaRecordAddLog is discarded when the function returns; caller receives no return value/error, UI shows normal completion, nothing is retried or reported
saveFailureSafety.readPathSafety: donomanaRecordReadLog guards missing key and non-array/unparseable JSON, returning [] -- read corruption does not crash the app, but also gives no visible signal that stored history was lost
saveFailureSafety.evidence: CODE-VERIFIED, sampled across nazori-app.html/hiragana-learn.html and confirmed byte-identical via grep across all 22 app files
